name: FreeQR
title: Free QR Code Generator for Links, Text & Wi-Fi
thesis: Ultra-fast, distraction-free, 100% client-side static QR code generator for links, text, and Wi-Fi networks with zero cloud telemetry and zero cookies.
single_job: Generate and download pristine static QR codes (PNG & SVG) instantly in browser.

required_blocks.purpose: Client-side matrix rendering to Canvas and SVG without cloud roundtrips
Sovereign header, brand identity, navigation, skip link, and 4-column footer sitemap
Real-time cookie count verification, zero-cookie guarantee, and GDPR/ePrivacy compliance audit
Client-side private storage inspector with export, import, and zero-trace wipe
Zero-flicker Paper White (#ffffff) and OLED Pure Black (#000000) with WCAG AAA high-contrast toggle
In-memory UI translation (EN, NL, FR, DE, ES) and SEO alternate hreflang tags
Structured XML sitemap, robots.txt, and Schema.org WebApplication & FAQPage JSON-LD
Progressive Web App service worker and web manifest for complete offline capability

constraints.strict_csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://othrys.be; object-src 'none';
